title: USJP HealthTech Hackathon
organizerName: Faculty of Medical Sciences Tech Cell
description: A cross-disciplinary hackathon pairing medical and computing students on patient-facing tools - appointment access, medication reminders and rural clinic record-keeping among past themes. Clinicians sit on the judging panel.
location: Faculty of Medical Sciences, University of Sri Jayewardenepura
whoCanParticipate: Open to undergraduates from any faculty; medical students especially encouraged to team up with developers.
